remarks: Palmer Hill Townhouse! Located on the Old Greenwich/Stamford border. "LIKE NEW", END UNIT, custom 3 bedrooms/3.5 baths + office/bedroom or playroom and 2 car garage. This private, light filled home has custom maple floors throughout and many special upgrades. The eat in kitchen has custom cabinets, glass backsplash, white marble counters, SS appliances, a large island and custom lighting. The 27 foot Living Room/Dining Room has custom lighting, a white marble gas fireplace, and French doors to your private patio. A powder room completes this floor. The upper floor has the primary bedroom suite, with a tray ceiling, 2 custom walk-in closets, a marble en-suite full bath with a makeup table and special soaking tub. There are 2 more bedrooms and full marble bath on this floor as well as a separate laundry room with a washer and dryer. The lower level is above ground with a full bath, and a spacious room that can serve as a bedroom, office or play room. There is a 2 car garage as well. Bring your decorating ideas and move right into this special, impeccable home. Amenities include a newly renovated clubhouse, pool, hot tub, fire pit, gym, yoga room and business center. Minutes to I95 and Metro North. Dog Friendly. Don't Miss This Move In Ready Home! Virtually Staged
